prompt:
Write a CommonJS JavaScript module. Export exactly the requested function with module.exports = functionName. Use no imports, dependencies, filesystem or network. Return only one fenced javascript code block, with no explanation.

Implement async function mapLimit(items, limit, fn). limit must be a positive integer; reject with RangeError otherwise. Call async fn(item, index) exactly once per item on successful runs, with at most limit pending invocations at any time. Resolve to results in original input order regardless of completion order. Empty items resolves to []. Do not mutate items. Reject if any callback throws or rejects, preserving its rejection reason. No ordering requirement for callback starts, and already running callbacks may finish after rejection.
